status: r3 — reduced from r2's 51-item declaration (35 cards/tools + 16 teamwork/planning rating cards) to a 20-card + 6-tool worker-flow contract per the approved P-3 design (docs/gates/P3.md). Safety (CON/N9001) is folded into 4 of the 20 cards rather than a separate 8-card block. Teamwork/plan-and-organise (CON/N8001, CON/N8002) are no longer represented as rating cards at all -- they are out of Q-1's self-declaration matching scope entirely (same as DGT/VSQ/N0101 always was), covered only by the worker's non-scored work-setting/prior-training choice and the assessor's own notes (see tasks.json.not_task_evidenced_nos and thresholds.json). This is a new rules id, not an in-place edit of r2's meaning, per docs/qp/CON_Q0602_v4_source_of_truth.md's version-change rule.
note: Each declaration item (a picture task card the worker taps often/sometimes/never, or a tool in the 6-item tool grid) links to the NOS/PC(s) it evidences, with a weight (0-1) for how directly it evidences that PC. Effective claim strength for a PC = max over its links of (answer_strength x link.weight), where answer_strength is often=1.0, sometimes=0.6, never=0.0 (thresholds.json). A PC with no link at all is out of scope for the match coverage calculation (it can still be scored later from task evidence -- see rubric.json) and is surfaced as an unprobed gap, never silently assumed absent.

cards.label: Fixed a loose wire or switch at home/site
Used a tester or multimeter to check if a wire has power
Used hand tools (pliers, screwdriver, wire stripper) for wiring work
Found and fixed a short circuit or no-power fault
Selected an MCB/breaker of the right rating for a circuit
Fitted a new light point or tube light
Fixed an MCB or fuse that had tripped/blown
Shifted or moved a temporary light/board to another spot
Worked with isolated/switched-off power before touching wires
Laid or ran a wire/conduit through a wall or ceiling
Connected a switch and socket
Connected an earth wire
Read a wiring diagram or connection chart
Assembled or wired a small distribution board / meter board
Inspected a panel/board for damage or wear
Mounted/secured a distribution board so it's protected from water, dust or damage
Wore full PPE (helmet, gloves, goggles, safety shoes) for the job
Took part in a safety briefing or Tool Box Talk before starting work
Knew the evacuation/emergency procedure for fire or accident at the site
Checked safety equipment (first-aid box, barricades, fire point) before starting work

known_gaps.note: PCs with no card/tool link are out of scope for the declaration match (they are never assumed absent; they are simply unprobed by the self-declaration and can only be judged from task evidence at assessment time). Reducing from r2's 51 items to 20 cards + 6 tools (r3) necessarily leaves more PCs unprobed than r2 did -- this is the accepted trade-off of a short, worker-friendly declaration; every scored NOS still has multiple linked cards (see tools/audit_qp_traceability.py's [decl] check) and T1-T5 task evidence remains the authoritative source for every PC regardless of declaration coverage.
known_gaps.scope: Listed PCs are within the 5 practical/scored NOS only (CON/N0602, CON/N0603, CON/N0604, CON/N0605, CON/N9001) -- computed by tools/audit_qp_traceability.py's companion script against the pinned QP. CON/N8001, CON/N8002 and DGT/VSQ/N0101 are entirely outside this declaration's scope (no cards ever linked to them, by design -- see links.json.status) and are not listed here; that is a scope decision, not an unprobed gap.
